resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says removed in 1948; firelookout.com and Willhite say destroyed in 1948. The story reports both verbs.

FFLOS gives 3,850 ft (1,173 m) and the Mountaineers say records place the lookout at 3,850 ft. Willhite's trip header lists 3,553 ft, which may refer to a different point. The story gives about 3,850 feet as the hike point the Mountaineers plan aims for, citing the Mountaineers page.

notes_for_editor: Corrections: none. No source read gives staffing for this lookout, so the staffing key is omitted. Access level omitted: Willhite gives directions but no access rule. Remains at the site come only from Willhite's captioned photos (captioned 2017); the captions do not say whether any item came from the lookout. The Mountaineers page is undated. Not visited by this run.
